anti_overlap: State machine correctness, not async lifecycle (fd-asyncio) or DB schema (fd-sqlalchemy)
decision_lens: Every state transition must be guarded, idempotent, and recoverable — phantom advance under duplicate signal is a critical failure mode
distance_rationale: Flight phase sequencing parallels OODARC stages — both are state machines where incorrect transitions have serious consequences
expected_isomorphisms: Squawk code deduplication maps to message idempotency; flight plan amendments map to /mode switching mid-conversation
focus: OODARC transition guards, idempotency under duplicate delivery, and crash recovery
name: fd-air-traffic-state-sequencing
persona: ATC systems engineer who designs flight phase sequencing and safety interlocks
review_areas: OODARC stage transition completeness: can the system get stuck between stages?
Idempotency under duplicate Telegram webhook delivery (at-least-once semantics)
Race condition between SPO extraction and OODARC stage evaluation on same turn
Crash recovery: what happens mid-turn if the process restarts?
Session re-entry after timeout: does stale context from hours ago cause confusion?
Command handlers (/new, /mode) as manual override — do they properly reset state?

severity_examples.condition: Telegram retries webhook, both invocations run extraction
severity_examples.scenario: Duplicate webhook delivery processes same message twice, double-extracts

severity_examples.condition: Response sent to Telegram but not stored, next turn has gap in context
severity_examples.scenario: Process crash between Claude response and DB write loses the response

success_hints: Focus on agent.py handle_message flow and telegram.py webhook/polling paths
task_context: F8 (state checkpoint) needs to know what state exists to checkpoint
